::: {#exm-teacher-forcing}

#### Inputs and targets in `train_lm()`

```{python}
#| code-fold: show
window_x = decode(train_ids[0:20])
window_y = decode(train_ids[1:21])
print(repr(window_x))
print(repr(window_y))
```

`train_lm()` uses [teacher forcing](#def-teacher-forcing).
The two printed lines are the input and the target for a window that starts at the first character:
the target is the input moved one character on.
At each position,
the [cross-entropy loss](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/logistic-regression.html#def-cross-entropy-loss) compares the network's prediction with the next character of the true text,
whatever the network predicted before.

:::
